scope: Evaluator-only authored ordinary reference baseline from the stipulated synthetic case. This incomplete archive is neither empirical evidence nor a recommended correct solution. Absence from it supports no global novelty inference.

families.plain_description: Use a cutting pattern for each table size.
families.actor_operation_target: Workers calibrate seam and fit allowances separately on the three reference tables and update cutting cards.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Size-specific allowances reduce repeated seam opening where one common allowance fits poorly.
families.conditions: Honor printed designs, purchased cloth, wash durability, waste limit, and change budget.
families.assumptions: Reference-table dimensions adequately represent at least part of customer demand.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Check an initial sewn cover before cutting the remainder.
families.actor_operation_target: Workers complete and fit one representative cover per relevant size or cloth variation before releasing matching cuts.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Early feedback prevents a repeated cutting or allowance error spreading through the batch.
families.conditions: Maintain the delivery date and no more than eight percent cutting waste.
families.assumptions: Representative first pieces expose systematic problems without excessive setup time.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Confirm actual table dimensions and corner shape.
families.actor_operation_target: Cooperative gathers a short measurement checklist from customers with uncertain orders and records it beside the cutting instruction.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Accurate inputs reduce mismatch between nominal tables and fitted covers.
families.conditions: Retain accepted size and design commitments and finish within three weeks.
families.assumptions: Customers can measure reliably and needed fitting differences can be accommodated within the stock.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Make corner retention tolerate small shape differences.
families.actor_operation_target: Workers trial revised pockets or inexpensive washable elastic that allows limited adjustment during placement.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Compliant retention may accommodate rounded corners and modest dimensional variation without seam rework.
families.conditions: Remain removable without tools, pass the same wash test, and respect budget and stock limits.
families.assumptions: Added flexibility can preserve the ordered visible design and a secure fit.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: How do fitting errors vary with actual table geometry and production conditions?
families.actor_operation_target: Workers compare dimensions, corners, size, cloth direction, design, and operator for successful and adjusted covers.
families.causal_path_or_observable: A comparison can identify which variables track rework and customer placement failures.
families.conditions: Use available records and willing customers without delaying delivery.
families.assumptions: Measurements are comparable and correlated factors can be distinguished cautiously.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: What shrinkage and working-time components remain unmeasured?
families.actor_operation_target: Workers measure offcut changes in both directions after washing and time cutting, sewing, fitting, and adjustment separately.
families.causal_path_or_observable: The measurements expose allowance uncertainty and locate avoidable rework time.
families.conditions: Use retained offcuts and the stipulated wash conditions within the existing budget.
families.assumptions: Offcuts represent purchased cloth and timing does not materially alter work.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs
